HuiYiTea v19.2.2 QR Code encoder

Bundled from qrcode-terminal 0.12.0, vendor/QRCode.
Upstream: https://github.com/gtanner/qrcode-terminal/tree/master/vendor/QRCode
Original QRCode JavaScript implementation: Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase,
MIT License; original copyright header remains in the browser bundle.
qrcode-terminal package and Node adaptations: Gord Tanner, Michael Brooks
and contributors; Apache License 2.0 supplied alongside.
No upstream NOTICE file was included in the installed 0.12.0 package.

Modifications for this distribution: modules placed in a static browser IIFE,
with an explicit UTF-8 adapter and a length-limited matrix-only public API.
QR matrix algorithms are unchanged. No terminal rendering code is bundled.
The application draws and downloads its QR images entirely in the browser.
No invitation, title or customer information is sent to any third-party
QR Code service. Node.js is not needed on the deployment host.
